recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the approved FHIR-33947 source change in the active CodeSystem narrative without taking on the separate, not-yet-applied ValueSet fragment work from FHIR-48959.
issue_request: FHIR-33947 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary change request for CodeSystem fragments. The approved resolution removed the old authority-only fragment publication bullet, moved the remaining clarity warning out of the fragment rule list, replaced the ContentMode fragment description with a curated-subset definition, and added a rule requiring the intent, bounds, and consequences of fragmentation to be clearly documented.
initial_application: Commit 7f35afd61a9ea5a8eb5b549051a8b07a5f600ae4 applied most of the resolution by updating the ContentMode fragment definition and adding the new intent/bounds/consequences rule. It did not remove the authority-only publication bullet from source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml, leaving the current narrative inconsistent with the final Jira decision.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists CodeSystem as a resource, so the CodeSystem source files are in build scope. FHIR-48959 is a later related ValueSet fragment issue but remains Resolved - change required and concerns expansion behavior. FHIR-51110 is a separate Applied content-mode clarification for the example code and does not supersede FHIR-33947. Zulip and Confluence searches found related discussion/minutes about relaxing fragment restrictions and reopening FHIR-33947 for the content-mode definition, with no conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: Removed the obsolete authority-only fragment publication bullet from source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml. The already-correct ContentMode fragment definition and the added intent/bounds/consequences rule were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml: removed the rule stating that fragments can only be published by the code system authority or an authority-defined process.

related_jiras.note: Later related ValueSet fragment expansion issue; useful context but still Resolved - change required and outside this applied CodeSystem fix.
Separate Applied content-mode clarification for the example code; confirms nearby terminology work but does not change the FHIR-33947 fragment publication rule.
